subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Challenge
solution: The correct answer is **"Dare."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Challenge"** means to invite somebody to fight, play, argue, etc. against you. (मुक़ाबले की चुनौती देना; ललकारना) • **Example**: *They’ve **challenged__** us to a football match this Saturday.* • Synonym of** Challenge** is **Dare.** • The word **"Dare"** means to have enough courage to do something. (साहस करना) __ • **Example**: *She **dared**__ to climb the highest peak in the region.* • The correct answer is Option 1. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Chagrin (Option 2)** means distress or embarrassment caused by failure or disappointment. (निराशा या खीज, खिसियाहट, संताप) • **Exert (Option 3)** means to put forth effort or energy towards a task. (किसी वस्‍तु को प्रयोग में लाना (जैसे प्रभाव, ताक़त आदि)) • **Acceptance (Option 4)** means the action of consenting to receive or undertake something offered. (स्‍वीकार करने या स्‍वीकार्य होने की क्रिया) 34:Tc11, The correct answer is **"Promote."**
